summary: Converts a 16-bit signed value a1 into a float scaled by 0.001 (the constant at flt_59E600) and stores the result through output pointer a2. Also returns the sign-extended integer form of a1. Called from terrain roughness/height sampling paths, suggesting a scaled unit conversion for short-encoded terrain data.

operations.description: Store (double)a1 * 0.001 as a float into *a2, reading the scale constant 0.001 from flt_59E600.
Return a1 sign-extended to int (result initialized from a1).

unresolved: Physical meaning of the 0.001 scale (e.g. meters per short unit, or a general per-caller scale) is not established.
Whether the integer return value is used by callers or only the out-parameter matters is unknown.
The two callers (TerrainSurfaceRoughnessHeightSampling 0x0045CA20, ShortArrayLookupAndZeroCheck 0x0045CBF0) are unverified-name functions.
